children: Braemar Hotels & Resorts declared preferred stock dividends for Q4 2026, specifying per-share amounts, payment and record dates.
Board declared Q4 dividend of $0.3438 for 5.5% Series B, payable Jan 15, 2027 to holders of record Dec 30, 2026.
Board declared Q4 dividend of $0.5156 for 8.25% Series D, payable Jan 15, 2027 to holders of record Dec 31, 2026.
Series E monthly dividends set at $0.15625 per share for Nov 16, Dec 15 and Jan 15 payment dates with respective record dates.
Series M monthly dividends set by CUSIP groups: $0.18125, $0.17917 and $0.17708 per share for Nov 16, Dec 15 and Jan 15 payments respectively.
As of Sept 30, 2026 there were 8,150,132 Series E and 1,269,981 Series M shares outstanding; additional redemption-requested shares noted.
